events.title: Draconid Meteor Shower: the one that happens at bedtime
events.when: Thu 10/08/2026 · from dark, best in the first hours
events.venue: Your own yard, or Big Lagoon State Park for a darker sky
events.summary: Nearly every meteor shower asks you to be awake at three in the morning. The Draconids do not: the radiant is highest as the sky goes dark, so the best hour is the one right after dinner. The moon is a four percent crescent that does not rise until quarter to five, which means the sky is as black as it gets all month.

sources.note: EarthSky: “The peak is predicted for 1 UTC on October 9, 2026” and “Under a dark sky with no moon, you might catch 10 Draconid meteors per hour.”
